instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '独立第三方审计（鉴证）'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有独立第三方ESG鉴证/核查报告？ 鉴证机构与准则（ISAE 3000/AA1000AS等）是什么？ 保证等级是有限保证还是合理保证？ 鉴证范围覆盖哪些指标与报告期？ 若无外部鉴证，是否披露内审路径与复核频率？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有董事会对ESG报告真实性声明；仅有ISO 45001/14001管理体系认证；仅有财务审计意见；仅有“数据已经核对”无机构无准则；区分：本指标是ESG数据独立鉴证；ISO体系认证不是ESG报告鉴证；温室气体核算关注方法学，鉴证关注外部保证结论。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

[Content]

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: In order to create a safe and healthy working environment and reduce the occupational safety risk to the lowest level, we have aligned health and safety policies and the ESG and ISO management system, as to ensure all business operations align with occupational health and safety standards. Fire facilities and condition of emergency exit inspection are carried out regularly every half year. The Group did not record any case regarding work-related fatalities or work injuries. To protect employees from occupational injuries, we have appropriate equipment in place. The fire drill is conducted annually for all the frontlines employees.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Training and Development

[Content]
In order to create a safe and healthy working environment and reduce the occupational safety risk to the lowest level, we have aligned health and safety policies and the ESG and ISO management system, as to ensure all business operations align with occupational health and safety standards. Fire facilities and condition of emergency exit inspection are carried out regularly every half year. The Group did not record any case regarding work-related fatalities or work injuries. To protect employees from occupational injuries, we have appropriate equipment in place. The fire drill is conducted annually for all the frontlines employees.

Materiality Assessment

[Content]
A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.
